representations.name: Separated Macaulay prefix and residual suffix
representations.new_information: Retains the maximal canonical prefix shared by two adjacent defect states and shadows only the separated lower-rank suffix; this is precisely the overlap information discarded by subadditivity.
representations.first_test: Prove the exact prefix-cancellation identity for every legal concatenated canonical word, then identify the first V and rank where the V and V+1 orbits fail to share the required prefix.

representations.name: Rank-six carry odometer
representations.new_information: Encodes the six-canonical word of W_6 by its upper indices, carry walls, and top-index excursions instead of by the scalar W_6 alone.
representations.first_test: Search exact adjacent states for a top index exceeding ceil(log_2 V)+13; a bounded scan is used only to locate counterexamples.

representations.name: Colex initial segment with a protected missing 8-set
representations.new_information: Realizes D_8<binom(V-11,8) as the existence of a concrete missing set after iterated lower shadows, preserving incidence and overlap that an integer defect forgets.
representations.first_test: Attempt to propagate one canonical missing set backward through every tax insertion; reject if the proposed witness is only a restatement of the numerical cap.

representations.name: Shadow-overlap incidence hypergraph
representations.new_information: Records which independently inserted V-taxes generate the same lower-shadow sets, making the recompression credit an explicit overlap term rather than an assumed cancellation.
representations.first_test: At V=40 compute the first two isolated shadow families and demand an injection from their overlap credit into the 2,581,865-unit overspend of the second tax.

representations.name: Adjacent residual-margin dynamics
representations.new_information: Uses M(V)=binom(V-13,6)-W_6(V), so the universal inequality reduces to the exact one-step suffix loss W_6(V+1)-W_6(V)<binom(V-13,5) plus one base case.
representations.first_test: Independently reconstruct adjacent exact orbits and falsify the one-step inequality at its first V; do not infer it from a finite cutoff.

representations.name: Normalized residual capacity
representations.new_information: Tracks rho(V)=W_6(V)/binom(V-13,6), allowing cap growth to absorb small positive W_6 jumps that invalidate scalar monotonicity.
representations.first_test: Cross-multiply exactly at adjacent parameters and kill on the first increase; separately test whether the proposed proof adds information beyond the adjacent-margin inequality.

representations.name: Reverse Galois capacity ledger
representations.new_information: Tracks the available binomial capacity backward from rank 8 while retaining the lower canonical suffix, so temporary crossings of the two-binomial P_q barrier are allowed.
representations.first_test: Replay V=288 and reject any capacity recurrence that forbids the exact D_16=P_16+67 excursion.

representations.name: Squarefree Hilbert-defect sequence
representations.new_information: Interprets the canonical shadow orbit as an O-sequence/Hilbert-function defect and exposes which inequalities use only rankwise dimension and which retain multiplication-map structure.
representations.first_test: Test whether a proposed log-concavity or persistence inequality survives the exact V=288 sign change relative to P_q; kill any theorem that only renames the Macaulay bound.

representations.name: Dyadic blocks of canonical carry walls
representations.new_information: Groups parameters V in [2^j,2^(j+1)) and charges a new rank-six top index only when the defect orbit crosses an explicit binomial wall, potentially yielding logarithmic carry height.
representations.first_test: For each observed top-index increase, verify the claimed doubling prerequisite exactly; one violation kills the proposed charging rule.

representations.name: Full threshold boundary ledger
representations.new_information: Keeps the all-V rank-eight entry, the inherited rank-eight-to-rank-two implication, the r-to-(V,n) construction map, and the independent lower obstruction as separate interfaces.
representations.first_test: Assume the all-V rank-eight entry and list every remaining quantified dependency; reject any claim that it alone determines n_0(r) or even yields an upper term without the parameter replay.
